# Duology

> Open-source (MIT) agent skills and Claude Code plugins for designing, building, testing and shipping native SwiftUI and UIKit apps on iPhone Duo, Apple's foldable iPhone with a 5.4-inch outer display and a 7.6-inch inner display. Built for Xcode 27.1 and iOS 27.1. A community project, not affiliated with Apple.

Start with the duo-start skill: it detects the app's setup and says which skill to load next. Each skill is a SKILL.md file with detail in its references/ folder. Every iPhone Duo API name in Duology is checked against the iOS 27.1 SDK; reference/api-index.md lists them with Apple's doc links, and its "Not in the SDK" section lists names that sound right but don't exist. Pick layouts by size class, never by UIScreen.main, device model or orientation.

## Start here

- [duo-start](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology/skills/duo-start/SKILL.md): Entry point. Detects SwiftUI or UIKit, new or existing app and the SDK, runs a first pass, routes to the other skills.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/AGENTS.md): How to use the skills from Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI and other agents, and the rules for changing this repo.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/README.md): What Duology is, how to install it, and what's inside.

## Foundation skills (plugin: duology)

- [duo-setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology/skills/duo-setup/SKILL.md): Xcode 27.1 next to an older Xcode, the iPhone Duo simulator in Device Hub, Xcode's agent connection, Swift 6 project settings.
- [duo-layout](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology/skills/duo-layout/SKILL.md): Size classes, uneven safe areas, reserved regions, ArrangementView and an even custom split; keeping controls off the fold.
- [duo-navigation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology/skills/duo-navigation/SKILL.md): Vertical toolbars and tab bars, tabs that become a sidebar, NavigationSplitView, sheets and overflow.
- [duo-continuity](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology/skills/duo-continuity/SKILL.md): Scroll position, playback, typed text, selection and navigation that survive fold, unfold, rotate and resize.
- [duo-scenes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology/skills/duo-scenes/SKILL.md): Second windows and their errors on the outer display, Split View, scene accessories such as the camera capture accessory, state per window, the scene life cycle through fold and unfold.

## Design skills (plugin: duology-design)

- [duo-patterns](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-design/skills/duo-patterns/SKILL.md): Eight layout patterns with SwiftUI recipes: list-detail, supporting pane, two-page, dual view, extended canvas, feed reflow, tabs to sidebar, displacement.
- [duo-design-system](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-design/skills/duo-design-system/SKILL.md): Design tokens by size class: spacing, margins, even-column grids, one type scale with Dynamic Type, Liquid Glass, concentric corners, colours and contrast, 44 pt targets.
- [duo-postures](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-design/skills/duo-postures/SKILL.md): What each pose needs (closed, open, book, tabletop, tent, flipped), tabletop media and book layouts from size classes and the fold region, the hinge for effects only.
- [duo-transitions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-design/skills/duo-transitions/SKILL.md): Fold and unfold without a reload: stable identity, opting a resize into animation, Reduce Motion, UIKit transition coordinators, 120 Hz budgets.
- [duo-ergonomics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-design/skills/duo-ergonomics/SKILL.md): Grips and thumb reach: primary actions near the hands, floating controls on the bar's side, nothing frequent at the top centre or on the fold, left-handed and right-to-left use.
- [duo-accessibility](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-design/skills/duo-accessibility/SKILL.md): VoiceOver order across panes and after a fold, Dynamic Type on the outer display, Reduce Motion, Increase Contrast, keyboard, Switch Control and Voice Control, audits in UI tests.
- [duo-shared-screen](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-design/skills/duo-shared-screen/SKILL.md): Two people using one phone at once: one half each, input per half, accessibility and UI tests.
- [duo-design-review](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-design/skills/duo-design-review/SKILL.md): A 15-point review of screenshots and Figma frames, with severity, rule and fix for each finding.

## iOS 27 feature skills (plugin: duology-features)

- [duo-intelligence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-features/skills/duo-intelligence/SKILL.md): Foundation Models on both displays: an AI pane beside the content when open, a short summary when closed, streaming that survives a fold, availability and fallbacks, Private Cloud Compute.
- [duo-app-intents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-features/skills/duo-app-intents/SKILL.md): App Intents that open the right pane or window from Siri, Shortcuts or the Action button, intents that work on the closed phone, testing with AppIntentsTesting.
- [duo-camera](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-features/skills/duo-camera/SKILL.md): The virtual front camera, choosing each camera by the way it faces, rotation and mirroring through a fold, a preview on the outer display, tabletop capture.
- [duo-media](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-features/skills/duo-media/SKILL.md): Playback that survives fold and unfold, the tabletop player, Picture in Picture, up next, Now Playing and the iOS 27 audio session notifications.
- [duo-reading](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-features/skills/duo-reading/SKILL.md): Books and documents: two facing pages open and in book pose, one page closed, the reader's place kept through a fold, notes beside the text.
- [duo-games](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-features/skills/duo-games/SKILL.md): Games that fill every pose, touch controls off the fold, the bottom half as a controller in tabletop, SpriteKit and Metal views that resize, game controllers.
- [duo-swiftui-27](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-features/skills/duo-swiftui-27/SKILL.md): The iOS 27 SwiftUI changes on both displays: reordering, swipe actions on any view, the @State macro (TN3211), prominent tabs, toolbar minimizing.
- [duo-system-surfaces](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-features/skills/duo-system-surfaces/SKILL.md): Widgets, Live Activities and the vertical Dynamic Island, StandBy and Controls on both displays.

## Test and ship skills (plugin: duology-ship)

- [duo-lint](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-ship/skills/duo-lint/SKILL.md): The fold linter. Finds main-screen sizing, orientation and idiom checks, hard-coded device sizes, fixed widths and UIRequiresFullScreen.
- [duo-testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-ship/skills/duo-testing/SKILL.md): Logic tests on the Mac and UI tests that work on the iPhone Duo simulator.
- [duo-pose-matrix](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-ship/skills/duo-pose-matrix/SKILL.md): Screenshots of an installed app closed, open, in book pose and in tabletop, by pressing Device Hub's pose buttons through the macOS Accessibility API with the user's permission, or poses set by hand.
- [duo-migrate](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-ship/skills/duo-migrate/SKILL.md): Moves an app that ships today to Xcode 27.1 and iPhone Duo: what its current SDK shows, the scene life cycle for UIKit apps, the patterns to fix in order.
- [duo-app-store](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-ship/skills/duo-app-store/SKILL.md): The App Store submission for iPhone Duo: screenshots of both displays at the exact sizes, App Review notes, the privacy manifest, the April 2027 rules.

## Recipes (plugin: duology-recipes)

- [recipe-two-player-game](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-recipes/skills/recipe-two-player-game/SKILL.md): Creates a two-player, one-phone SwiftUI game that builds and runs on the iPhone Duo simulator.
- [recipe-finance-dashboard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-recipes/skills/recipe-finance-dashboard/SKILL.md): Creates a personal finance dashboard: the balance and recent spending closed; the balance, a spending chart and the transactions side by side open.
- [recipe-media-player](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-recipes/skills/recipe-media-player/SKILL.md): Creates a video podcast player whose playback survives every fold, with video above the fold and controls below in tabletop.
- [recipe-reader](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-recipes/skills/recipe-reader/SKILL.md): Creates an e-book reader: one page closed, two facing pages open and in book pose, the reader's place kept through every fold.
- [recipe-shop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-recipes/skills/recipe-shop/SKILL.md): Creates a shop for digital packs with a basket, StoreKit 2 purchases and a subscription, tested with a local StoreKit configuration file.
- [recipe-kids-learning](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-recipes/skills/recipe-kids-learning/SKILL.md): Creates a learning app for young children: questions read aloud, big answers below the fold in tabletop, a parental gate, a privacy manifest and nothing tracked.
- [recipe-notes-ai](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-recipes/skills/recipe-notes-ai/SKILL.md): Creates a notes app with on-device AI summaries: one line closed, a pane beside the note open, a stream that survives every fold, and a summary without AI when the model can't run.

## Commands and agents (Claude Code)

- [/duo-ship](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-ship/commands/duo-ship.md): App Store checklist for iPhone Duo: the April 2027 build rules, duo-lint, every pose, screenshots of both displays, the privacy manifest and App Review notes. Never uploads.
- [duo-pose-tester agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-ship/agents/duo-pose-tester.md): Reads duo-pose-matrix runs (every pose, and while the app keeps running through a fold) and reports each failure with its screenshot. Reads only.
- [duo-design-reviewer agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-design/agents/duo-design-reviewer.md): Reviews screenshots or Figma exports with the 15-point checklist and the pose, reach and accessibility rules. Reads only.
- [/duo-review](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-design/commands/duo-review.md): Hands a folder of frames (default: the newest /duo-poses run) to the reviewer agent.
- [/duo-poses](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-ship/commands/duo-poses.md): Runs duo-pose-matrix on an installed app and puts the simulator back.
- [/duo-audit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-ship/commands/duo-audit.md): duo-lint plus the design checklist, most serious first.
- [/duo-new](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology-recipes/commands/duo-new.md): Creates an app from a recipe, tests its rules on the Mac, builds it and runs it on the iPhone Duo simulator.
- [/duo-doctor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/plugins/duology/commands/duo-doctor.md): Checks the Mac: Xcode 27.1, the iOS 27.1 runtime, an iPhone Duo simulator, Xcode's agent bridge and Python.

## Reference

- [API index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/reference/api-index.md): Every iPhone Duo API Duology uses, with its declaration, availability and Apple doc link.
- [Device facts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/reference/device-facts.md): Displays, size classes, cameras, the fold and poses, each with its source.
- [Sources](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kimeur/duology/main/reference/sources.md): The Apple pages, Tech Talks and prior art behind each rule.
